# GlobalStone — Global Commercial Real Estate Services

## Overview

Build a 5-page corporate website for **GlobalStone**, a global leader in commercial real estate services and investments. The site targets commercial real estate investors, occupiers, property owners, and corporate clients. It must project authority, sophistication, and scale — think CBRE or JLL-level polish. The tone is **professional, modern, and elegant** throughout.

## Visual & Style Direction

- **Color palette:** Deep navy (#0A1628) as the primary dark tone, paired with white, cool grays, and a refined accent — gold or teal — for CTAs and highlights. Avoid anything playful or startup-ish.
- **Typography:** Use a clean sans-serif (e.g., Inter or similar) for body text and a slightly bolder weight or contrasting serif for headlines to convey gravitas.
- **Imagery mood:** Use placeholder images suggesting skylines, modern office towers, and architectural interiors. Large hero images with subtle overlays set the tone on every page.
- **Spacing & layout:** Generous whitespace, structured grids, and clear visual hierarchy. This is a content-rich site — clarity is paramount.

## Key Priorities

1. **The mega menu navigation** is the most complex interactive element. On desktop, hovering/clicking "Services" must reveal a well-organized dropdown with service categories and property types. On mobile, this collapses into accordion-style navigation. Get this right — it's the primary wayfinding mechanism across all 5 pages.

2. **The "What We Do" tabbed section** on the homepage (vertical tabs switching content panels) is a signature interaction that must feel smooth and polished.

3. **Service detail pages** (Invest/Finance/Value, Plan/Lease/Occupy, Design & Build) each have capabilities grids — these must be scannable, consistent in structure, and link logically back to the services overview.

4. **The homepage is dense** — hero, featured insights, announcement banner, about statement, services preview, newsletter CTA, latest insights, and commitment pillars. Prioritize visual rhythm so it doesn't feel overwhelming.

The site must be fully responsive with no build step required.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

React framework with SSR, SSG, RSC, and optimization features **Turborepo** - High-performance monorepo build system for JavaScript/TypeScript **RemixIcon** - Icon library with 3,100+ outlined and filled style icons ## When to Use This Skill Group - Building new full-stack web applications with modern React - Setting up monorepos with multiple apps and shared packages - Implementing server-side rendering and static generation - Optimizing build performance with intelligent caching - Creating consistent UI with professional iconography - Managing workspace dependencies across multiple projects - Deploying production-ready applications with proper optimization ## Stack Selection Guide ### Single Application: Next.js + RemixIcon Use when building a standalone application: - E-commerce sites - Marketing websites - SaaS applications - Documentation sites - Blogs and content platforms **Setup:** ```bash npx create-next-app@latest my-app cd my-app npm install remixicon ``` ### Monorepo: Next.js + Turborepo + RemixIcon Use when building multiple applications with shared code: - Microfrontends - Multi-tenant platforms - Internal tools with shared component library - Multiple apps (web, admin, mobile-web) sharing logic - Design system with documentation site **Setup:** ```bash npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo # Then configure Next.js apps in apps/ directory # Install remixicon in shared UI packages ``` ### Framework Features Comparison | Feature | Next.js | Turborepo | RemixIcon | |---------|---------|-----------|-----------| | Primary Use | Web framework | Build system | UI icons | | Best For | SSR/SSG apps | Monorepos | Consistent iconography | | Performance | Built-in optimization | Caching & parallel tasks | Lightweight fonts/SVG | | TypeScript | Full support | Full support | Type definitions available | ## Quick Start ### Next.js Application ```bash # Create new project npx create-next-app@latest my-app cd my-app # Install RemixIcon npm install remixicon # Import in layout # app/layout.tsx import 'remixicon/fonts/remixicon.css' # Start development npm run dev ``` ### Turborepo Monorepo ```bash # Create monorepo npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo cd my-monorepo # Structure: # apps/web/ - Next.js application # apps/docs/ - Documentation site # packages/ui/ - Shared components with RemixIcon # packages/config/ - Shared configs # turbo.json - Pipeline configuration # Run all apps npm run dev # Build all packages npm run build ``` ### RemixIcon Integration ```tsx // Webfont (HTML/CSS) // React component import { RiHomeLine, RiSearchFill } from "@remixicon/react" ``` ## Reference Navigation **Next.js References:** - [App Router Architecture](./references/nextjs-app-router.md) - Routing, layouts, pages, parallel routes - [Server Components](./references/nextjs-server-components.md) - RSC patterns, client vs server, streaming - [Data Fetching](./references/nextjs-data-fetching.md) - fetch API, caching, revalidation, loading states - [Optimization](./references/nextjs-optimization.md) - Images, fonts, scripts, bundle analysis, PPR **Turborepo References:** - [Setup & Configuration](./references/turborepo-setup.md) - Installation, workspace config, package structure - [Task Pipelines](./references/turborepo-pipelines.md) - Dependencies, parallel execution, task ordering - [Caching Strategies](./references/turborepo-caching.md) - Local cache, remote cache, cache invalidation **RemixIcon References:** - [Integration Guide](./references/remix-icon-integration.md) - Installation, usage, customization, accessibility ## Common Patterns & Workflows ### Pattern 1: Full-Stack Monorepo ``` my-monorepo/ ├── apps/ │ ├── web/ # Customer-facing Next.js app │ ├── admin/ # Admin dashboard Next.js app │ └── docs/ # Documentation site ├── packages/ │ ├── ui/ # Shared UI with RemixIcon │ ├── api-client/ # API client library │ ├── config/ # ESLint, TypeScript configs │ └── types/ # Shared TypeScript types └── turbo.json # Build pipeline ``` **turbo.json:** ```json { "$schema": "https://turbo.build/schema.json", "pipeline": { "build": { "dependsOn": ["^build"], "outputs": [".next/**", "!.next/cache/**", "dist/**"] }, "dev": { "cache": false, "persistent": true }, "lint": {}, "test": { "dependsOn": ["build"] } } } ``` ### Pattern 2: Shared Component Library ```tsx // packages/ui/src/button.tsx import { RiLoader4Line } from "@remixicon/react" export function Button({ children, loading, icon }) { return ( ) } // apps/web/app/page.tsx import { Button } from "@repo/ui/button" import { RiHomeLine } from "@remixicon/react" export default function Page() { return } ``` ### Pattern 3: Optimized Data Fetching ```tsx // app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx import { notFound } from 'next/navigation' // Static generation at build time export async function generateStaticParams() { const posts = await getPosts() return posts.map(post => ({ slug: post.slug })) } // Revalidate every hour async function getPost(slug: string) { const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${slug}`, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } }) if (!res.ok) return null return res.json() } export default async function Post({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) { const post = await getPost(params.slug) if (!post) notFound() return
{post.content}
} ``` ### Pattern 4: Monorepo CI/CD Pipeline ```yaml # .github/workflows/ci.yml name: CI on: [push, pull_request] jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: 18 - run: npm install - run: npx turbo run build test lint env: TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }} TURBO_TEAM: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TEAM }} ``` ## Utility Scripts Python utilities in `scripts/` directory: **nextjs-init.py** - Initialize Next.js project with best practices **turborepo-migrate.py** - Convert existing monorepo to Turborepo Usage examples: ```bash # Initialize new Next.js app with TypeScript and recommended setup python scripts/nextjs-init.py --name my-app --typescript --app-router # Migrate existing monorepo to Turborepo with dry-run python scripts/turborepo-migrate.py --path ./my-monorepo --dry-run # Run tests cd scripts/tests pytest ``` ## Best Practices **Next.js:** - Default to Server Components, use Client Components only when needed - Implement proper loading and error states - Use Image component for automatic optimization - Set proper metadata for SEO - Leverage caching strategies (force-cache, revalidate, no-store) **Turborepo:** - Structure monorepo with clear separation (apps/, packages/) - Define task dependencies correctly (^build for topological) - Configure outputs for proper caching - Enable remote caching for team collaboration - Use filters to run tasks on changed packages only **RemixIcon:** - Use line style for minimal interfaces, fill for emphasis - Maintain 24x24 grid alignment for crisp rendering - Provide aria-labels for accessibility - Use currentColor for flexible theming - Prefer webfonts for multiple icons, SVG for single icons ## Resources - Next.js: https://nextjs.org/docs/llms.txt - Turborepo: https://turbo.build/repo/docs - RemixIcon: https://remixicon.com ## Implementation Checklist Building with this stack: - [ ] Implement routing and layouts - [ ] Add loading and error states - [ ] Configure image and font optimization - [ ] Set up data fetching patterns - [ ] Configure caching strategies - [ ] Add API routes as needed - {
  "application": "web-design",
  "case_id": "case-real-estate-corporate-globalstone",
  "language": "en",
  "site": {
    "type": "corporate",
    "page_count": 5,
    "audience": "commercial real estate investors, occupiers, property owners, and corporate clients",
    "tone": "professional, modern, elegant",
    "responsive": true,
    "dark_mode": false
  },
  "brief": {
    "title": "GlobalStone — Global Commercial Real Estate Services",
    "one_liner": "GlobalStone is the global leader in commercial real estate services and investments, providing integrated, data-led solutions across every dimension of real estate.",
    "goal": "Establish authority as the premier commercial real estate services firm, showcase the breadth of service offerings, and drive engagement with potential clients across investment, leasing, design, and property management needs."
  },
  "pages": [
    {
      "page_id": "home",
      "file": "index.html",
      "sections": [
        "header",
        "hero",
        "featured-insights",
        "announcement-banner",
        "about-statement",
        "what-we-do",
        "newsletter",
        "latest-insights",
        "our-commitment",
        "footer"
      ],
      "objective": "Serve as the main landing page that communicates the company's global leadership, showcases key services, highlights latest insights and research, and provides pathways to explore services and careers."
    },
    {
      "page_id": "services",
      "file": "services.html",
      "sections": [
        "header",
        "hero",
        "intro-statement",
        "service-categories",
        "footer"
      ],
      "objective": "Present an overview of all commercial real estate service categories with brief descriptions and links to explore each service area in detail."
    },
    {
      "page_id": "invest-finance-value",
      "file": "services-invest-finance-value.html",
      "sections": [
        "header",
        "hero",
        "intro-statement",
        "capabilities-grid",
        "featured-partners",
        "deal-flow-cta",
        "testimonial",
        "featured-topics",
        "property-types-cta",
        "related-services",
        "related-insights",
        "footer"
      ],
      "objective": "Detail the investment, finance, and valuation services including capabilities like capital markets, valuation, forecasting, and sustainability solutions, with social proof and related content."
    },
    {
      "page_id": "plan-lease-occupy",
      "file": "services-plan-lease-occupy.html",
      "sections": [
        "header",
        "hero",
        "intro-statement",
        "capabilities-grid",
        "what-we-do",
        "related-insights",
        "footer"
      ],
      "objective": "Showcase planning, leasing, and occupancy services including transaction services, site selection, workplace solutions, lease administration, portfolio strategy, and consulting capabilities."
    },
    {
      "page_id": "design-build",
      "file": "services-design-build.html",
      "sections": [
        "header",
        "hero",
        "intro-statement",
        "capabilities",
        "partnership-highlight",
        "footer"
      ],
      "objective": "Present design and build services including project management and supply chain sourcing capabilities, along with a strategic partnership highlight."
    }
  ],
  "navigation": [
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Services nav link",
      "to": "services"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Learn More link in about statement",
      "to": "services"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Explore Services link in What We Do section",
      "to": "services"
    },
    {
      "from": "services",
      "trigger": "Invest, Finance & Value - Explore Service link",
      "to": "invest-finance-value"
    },
    {
      "from": "services",
      "trigger": "Plan, Lease & Occupy - Explore Service link",
      "to": "plan-lease-occupy"
    },
    {
      "from": "services",
      "trigger": "Design & Build - Explore Service link",
      "to": "design-build"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Invest, Finance & Value mega menu link",
      "to": "invest-finance-value"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Plan, Lease & Occupy mega menu link",
      "to": "plan-lease-occupy"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Design & Build mega menu link",
      "to": "design-build"
    }
  ],
  "interactions": [
    {
      "id": "nav-services-dropdown",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "Click or hover on Services in the main navigation",
      "expected": "A mega menu dropdown opens showing service categories organized by Needs (Invest Finance & Value, Plan Lease & Occupy, Design & Build, Manage Properties & Portfolios, Transform Business Outcomes) and Property Types (Office, Retail, Industrial, Multifamily, Hotels)",
      "type": "toggle"
    },
    {
      "id": "nav-accordion-mobile",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "Click on accordion items in mobile navigation",
      "expected": "Navigation accordion sections expand and collapse to reveal sub-navigation links",
      "type": "toggle"
    },
    {
      "id": "invest-carousel",
      "page": "invest-finance-value",
      "trigger": "Interact with carousel controls in the featured partners section",
      "expected": "Carousel slides between featured partner content cards",
      "type": "state-change"
    },
    {
      "id": "what-we-do-tabs",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "Click on vertical tab labels (Insights & Research, Services, Careers) in What We Do section",
      "expected": "Content panel switches to show the corresponding service area description and call-to-action",
      "type": "state-change"
    },
    {
      "id": "newsletter-subscribe",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "Click Subscribe button in Our Take Newsletter section",
      "expected": "Opens newsletter subscription form or navigates to subscription page",
      "type": "navigation"
    }
  ],
  "data_display": [
    {
      "id": "services-overview-grid",
      "page": "services",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Service Categories",
      "expected_content": [
        "Invest, Finance & Value",
        "Plan, Lease & Occupy",
        "Design & Build",
        "Manage Properties & Portfolios",
        "Transform Business Outcomes",
        "Invest in Real Assets"
      ],
      "description": "Grid of six service categories each with a title, description paragraph, and Explore Service link"
    },
    {
      "id": "invest-capabilities",
      "page": "invest-finance-value",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Investment Capabilities",
      "expected_content": [
        "Capital Markets",
        "Valuation & Advisory Services",
        "Global Forecasting & Analytics",
        "Sustainability Solutions",
        "Transform Business Outcomes",
        "Strategic Investment Consulting"
      ],
      "description": "Grid of six capability areas under Invest, Finance & Value with descriptions and explore links"
    },
    {
      "id": "invest-featured-topics",
      "page": "invest-finance-value",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Featured Topics",
      "expected_content": [
        "Intelligent Investment",
        "Future Cities",
        "Adaptive Spaces",
        "Evolving Workforces"
      ],
      "description": "Sidebar list of featured research topics related to investment services"
    },
    {
      "id": "plan-lease-capabilities",
      "page": "plan-lease-occupy",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Planning and Leasing Capabilities",
      "expected_content": [
        "Transaction Services",
        "Site Selection & Location Strategy",
        "Workplace Solutions",
        "Experience Services",
        "Lease Administration",
        "Portfolio Strategy"
      ],
      "description": "Grid of ten capability areas under Plan, Lease & Occupy including transaction services, workplace solutions, and consulting"
    },
    {
      "id": "design-build-capabilities",
      "page": "design-build",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Design and Build Capabilities",
      "expected_content": [
        "Project & Program Management",
        "Supply Chain Sourcing"
      ],
      "description": "Two capability cards for design and build services with descriptions and explore links"
    },
    {
      "id": "home-commitment-pillars",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Our Commitment",
      "expected_content": [
        "Our Story",
        "Corporate Responsibility",
        "Sustainability",
        "Our Values-Driven Culture"
      ],
      "description": "Four commitment pillars displayed as cards with descriptions and Read More links"
    },
    {
      "id": "home-latest-insights",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Latest Insights",
      "expected_content": [
        "North America Data Center Trends H2 2025",
        "U.S. Real Estate Market Outlook 2026",
        "Back in the Game: As lenders return, CRE financing options expand"
      ],
      "description": "Three latest insight cards with category tags, titles, dates, and thumbnail images"
    }
  ]
}

1	# GlobalStone — Global Commercial Real Estate Services
2	
3	## Brand
4	GlobalStone is the global leader in commercial real estate services and investments, providing integrated, data-led solutions across every dimension of real estate. With services, insights, and data that span every dimension of the industry, we create solutions for clients of every size, in every sector, and across every geography.
5	
6	Brand colors: #003F2D (deep forest green — primary), #012A2D (dark teal — secondary), #E6E6E6 (light gray — neutral)
7	
8	## Hero Content
9	Title: Investors Signal Their 2026 Real Estate Priorities
10	Subtitle: Explore how investor sentiment, sector priorities, and strategy changes are reshaping real estate in 2026.
11	CTA: "Read the Report"
12	
13	## Featured Insights (Homepage)
14	- **The Weekly Take Podcast** — Back in the Game: As Lenders Return, CRE Financing Options Expand
15	- **Explore Healthcare** — Law Firm Benchmarking Survey Highlights 2026
16	- **Business Mobility** — The Shifting Landscape of Headquarters Relocations: 2026 Update
17	
18	## Announcement Banner
19	"Record Data Center Demand Drives Vacancy to New Lows"
20	CTA: "Explore the Report"
21	
22	## About Statement
23	We are the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services. With services, insights and data that span every dimension of the industry, we create solutions for clients of every size, in every sector and across every geography.
24	CTA: "Learn More" → Services
25	
26	## What We Do (Tabbed Section)
27	- **Insights & Research** — Our 500+ global researchers offer actionable intelligence and a multi-dimensional perspective that is unparalleled in the industry. CTA: "Explore Insights & Research"
28	- **Services** — Let us help you: Invest in real estate · Plan, lease & occupy · Design & build · Manage properties & portfolios · Transform business outcomes. CTA: "Explore Services"
29	- **Careers** — We don't just realize the potential in real estate. We help you realize your potential. CTA: "Explore Careers"
30	
31	## Our Take Newsletter
32	Title: Our Take Newsletter
33	Subtitle: Expert perspectives on what matters most in commercial real estate.
34	CTA: "Subscribe"
35	
36	## Latest Insights
37	- **Book | Intelligent Investment** — North America Data Center Trends H2 2025 — February 25, 2026
38	- **Book | Intelligent Investment** — U.S. Real Estate Market Outlook 2026 — January 14, 2026
39	- **Podcast | Intelligent Investment** — Back in the Game: As lenders return, CRE financing options expand — April 14, 2026
40	
41	## Our Commitment
42	- **Our Story** — We bring the diverse knowledge of our people, clients, and partners to realize potential in every business and every person. CTA: "Read More"
43	- **Corporate Responsibility** — We take great pride in our reputation for upholding the highest standards in the way we do business. CTA: "Read More"
44	- **Sustainability** — Accelerating sustainability by decarbonizing our own operations and influencing the way buildings are built, sourced, managed, occupied and sold. CTA: "Read More"
45	- **Our Values-Driven Culture** — We help our employees learn, grow and stay safe and well while also engaging in our communities. CTA: "Read More"
46	
47	## Service Categories
48	- **Invest, Finance & Value** — As the global commercial real estate brokerage leader, GlobalStone is your strategic partner across the entire real estate investment lifecycle. CTA: "Explore Service"
49	- **Plan, Lease & Occupy** — As the #1 advisory and transactions firm in the world, GlobalStone offers unique insight, experience, and solutions to serve the needs of occupiers and owners. CTA: "Explore Service"
50	- **Design & Build** — GlobalStone examines every aspect of your business or investment strategy to plan, design, develop, and deliver real estate. CTA: "Explore Service"
51	- **Manage Properties & Portfolios** — Comprehensive property and facilities management solutions that maximize asset value and operational efficiency. CTA: "Explore Service"
52	- **Transform Business Outcomes** — Strategic consulting and technology-driven solutions that align real estate with broader enterprise goals. CTA: "Explore Service"
53	- **Invest in Real Assets** — Direct investment management across diversified real asset strategies for institutional and private investors. CTA: "Explore Service"
54	
55	## Investment Capabilities
56	- **Capital Markets** — Global expertise in investment sales, debt and structured finance, and recapitalization services across all property types and geographies.
57	- **Valuation & Advisory Services** — Independent, defensible valuations and strategic advisory powered by the industry's largest team of credentialed professionals.
58	- **Global Forecasting & Analytics** — Proprietary econometric models and market intelligence that inform investment timing, asset selection, and portfolio construction.
59	- **Sustainability Solutions** — ESG strategy, green building certification, and decarbonization advisory to future-proof assets and meet regulatory requirements.
60	- **Transform Business Outcomes** — Data-driven consulting that connects real estate decisions to enterprise performance metrics.
61	- **Strategic Investment Consulting** — Portfolio strategy, fund structuring, and capital allocation advisory for institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.
62	
63	## Featured Topics
64	- Intelligent Investment
65	- Future Cities
66	- Adaptive Spaces
67	- Evolving Workforces
68	
69	## Planning and Leasing Capabilities
70	- **Transaction Services** — Tenant and landlord representation for office, industrial, retail, and specialty property leasing across global markets.
71	- **Site Selection & Location Strategy** — Data-driven analysis combining labor analytics, incentives evaluation, and market benchmarking to optimize location decisions.
72	- **Workplace Solutions** — Workplace strategy, change management, and space programming that align physical environments with workforce needs.
73	- **Experience Services** — Hospitality-inspired facility experiences that elevate employee engagement and workplace satisfaction.
74	- **Lease Administration** — Technology-enabled lease abstraction, compliance tracking, and critical date management for complex portfolios.
75	- **Portfolio Strategy** — Holistic occupancy planning, scenario modeling, and cost optimization across multi-market portfolios.
76	
77	## Design and Build Capabilities
78	- **Project & Program Management** — End-to-end oversight of construction and renovation projects, from feasibility and design coordination through delivery and closeout.
79	- **Supply Chain Sourcing** — Strategic procurement and vendor management that reduce costs, mitigate risk, and accelerate project timelines.
80	
81	## Partnership Highlight
82	GlobalStone's Design & Build division partners with leading architecture, engineering, and construction firms worldwide to deliver turnkey solutions. Our integrated approach ensures seamless coordination from concept through occupancy, reducing timelines by an average of 18% and delivering cost savings of up to 12%.
83	
84	## Navigation Structure
85	**Main Nav:** Services · Insights & Research · Properties · People & Offices · Careers · About Us
86	
87	**Services Mega Menu — By Need:** Invest, Finance & Value · Plan, Lease & Occupy · Design & Build · Manage Properties & Portfolios · Transform Business Outcomes
88	
89	**Services Mega Menu — By Property Type:** Office · Retail · Industrial · Multifamily · Hotels
90	
91	## Footer Navigation
92	About GlobalStone · Careers · Corporate Responsibility · Investor Relations · Newsroom
93	Legal: Contact Us · Global Privacy and Cookie Notice · Terms of Use · Digital Accessibility

# GlobalStone — Global Commercial Real Estate Services

## Brand
GlobalStone is the global leader in commercial real estate services and investments, providing integrated, data-led solutions across every dimension of real estate. With services, insights, and data that span every dimension of the industry, we create solutions for clients of every size, in every sector, and across every geography.

Brand colors: #003F2D (deep forest green — primary), #012A2D (dark teal — secondary), #E6E6E6 (light gray — neutral)

## Hero Content
Title: Investors Signal Their 2026 Real Estate Priorities
Subtitle: Explore how investor sentiment, sector priorities, and strategy changes are reshaping real estate in 2026.
CTA: "Read the Report"

## Featured Insights (Homepage)
- **The Weekly Take Podcast** — Back in the Game: As Lenders Return, CRE Financing Options Expand
- **Explore Healthcare** — Law Firm Benchmarking Survey Highlights 2026
- **Business Mobility** — The Shifting Landscape of Headquarters Relocations: 2026 Update

## Announcement Banner
"Record Data Center Demand Drives Vacancy to New Lows"
CTA: "Explore the Report"

## About Statement
We are the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services. With services, insights and data that span every dimension of the industry, we create solutions for clients of every size, in every sector and across every geography.
CTA: "Learn More" → Services

## What We Do (Tabbed Section)
- **Insights & Research** — Our 500+ global researchers offer actionable intelligence and a multi-dimensional perspective that is unparalleled in the industry. CTA: "Explore Insights & Research"
- **Services** — Let us help you: Invest in real estate · Plan, lease & occupy · Design & build · Manage properties & portfolios · Transform business outcomes. CTA: "Explore Services"
- **Careers** — We don't just realize the potential in real estate. We help you realize your potential. CTA: "Explore Careers"

## Our Take Newsletter
Title: Our Take Newsletter
Subtitle: Expert perspectives on what matters most in commercial real estate.
CTA: "Subscribe"

## Latest Insights
- **Book | Intelligent Investment** — North America Data Center Trends H2 2025 — February 25, 2026
- **Book | Intelligent Investment** — U.S. Real Estate Market Outlook 2026 — January 14, 2026
- **Podcast | Intelligent Investment** — Back in the Game: As lenders return, CRE financing options expand — April 14, 2026

## Our Commitment
- **Our Story** — We bring the diverse knowledge of our people, clients, and partners to realize potential in every business and every person. CTA: "Read More"
- **Corporate Responsibility** — We take great pride in our reputation for upholding the highest standards in the way we do business. CTA: "Read More"
- **Sustainability** — Accelerating sustainability by decarbonizing our own operations and influencing the way buildings are built, sourced, managed, occupied and sold. CTA: "Read More"
- **Our Values-Driven Culture** — We help our employees learn, grow and stay safe and well while also engaging in our communities. CTA: "Read More"

## Service Categories
- **Invest, Finance & Value** — As the global commercial real estate brokerage leader, GlobalStone is your strategic partner across the entire real estate investment lifecycle. CTA: "Explore Service"
- **Plan, Lease & Occupy** — As the #1 advisory and transactions firm in the world, GlobalStone offers unique insight, experience, and solutions to serve the needs of occupiers and owners. CTA: "Explore Service"
- **Design & Build** — GlobalStone examines every aspect of your business or investment strategy to plan, design, develop, and deliver real estate. CTA: "Explore Service"
- **Manage Properties & Portfolios** — Comprehensive property and facilities management solutions that maximize asset value and operational efficiency. CTA: "Explore Service"
- **Transform Business Outcomes** — Strategic consulting and technology-driven solutions that align real estate with broader enterprise goals. CTA: "Explore Service"
- **Invest in Real Assets** — Direct investment management across diversified real asset strategies for institutional and private investors. CTA: "Explore Service"

## Investment Capabilities
- **Capital Markets** — Global expertise in investment sales, debt and structured finance, and recapitalization services across all property types and geographies.
- **Valuation & Advisory Services** — Independent, defensible valuations and strategic advisory powered by the industry's largest team of credentialed professionals.
- **Global Forecasting & Analytics** — Proprietary econometric models and market intelligence that inform investment timing, asset selection, and portfolio construction.
- **Sustainability Solutions** — ESG strategy, green building certification, and decarbonization advisory to future-proof assets and meet regulatory requirements.
- **Transform Business Outcomes** — Data-driven consulting that connects real estate decisions to enterprise performance metrics.
- **Strategic Investment Consulting** — Portfolio strategy, fund structuring, and capital allocation advisory for institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

## Featured Topics
- Intelligent Investment
- Future Cities
- Adaptive Spaces
- Evolving Workforces

## Planning and Leasing Capabilities
- **Transaction Services** — Tenant and landlord representation for office, industrial, retail, and specialty property leasing across global markets.
- **Site Selection & Location Strategy** — Data-driven analysis combining labor analytics, incentives evaluation, and market benchmarking to optimize location decisions.
- **Workplace Solutions** — Workplace strategy, change management, and space programming that align physical environments with workforce needs.
- **Experience Services** — Hospitality-inspired facility experiences that elevate employee engagement and workplace satisfaction.
- **Lease Administration** — Technology-enabled lease abstraction, compliance tracking, and critical date management for complex portfolios.
- **Portfolio Strategy** — Holistic occupancy planning, scenario modeling, and cost optimization across multi-market portfolios.

## Design and Build Capabilities
- **Project & Program Management** — End-to-end oversight of construction and renovation projects, from feasibility and design coordination through delivery and closeout.
- **Supply Chain Sourcing** — Strategic procurement and vendor management that reduce costs, mitigate risk, and accelerate project timelines.

## Partnership Highlight
GlobalStone's Design & Build division partners with leading architecture, engineering, and construction firms worldwide to deliver turnkey solutions. Our integrated approach ensures seamless coordination from concept through occupancy, reducing timelines by an average of 18% and delivering cost savings of up to 12%.

## Navigation Structure
**Main Nav:** Services · Insights & Research · Properties · People & Offices · Careers · About Us

**Services Mega Menu — By Need:** Invest, Finance & Value · Plan, Lease & Occupy · Design & Build · Manage Properties & Portfolios · Transform Business Outcomes

**Services Mega Menu — By Property Type:** Office · Retail · Industrial · Multifamily · Hotels

## Footer Navigation
About GlobalStone · Careers · Corporate Responsibility · Investor Relations · Newsroom
Legal: Contact Us · Global Privacy and Cookie Notice · Terms of Use · Digital Accessibility

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>GlobalStone — Global Commercial Real Estate Services</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        *, *::before, *::after {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --navy: #0A1628;
            --navy-light: #1A2B4A;
            --teal: #0D7377;
            --teal-light: #14919B;
            --gold: #C9A227;
            --gold-light: #D4AF37;
            --white: #FFFFFF;
            --gray-50: #F8FAFC;
            --gray-100: #F1F5F9;
            --gray-200: #E2E8F0;
            --gray-300: #CBD5E1;
            --gray-400: #94A3B8;
            --gray-500: #64748B;
            --gray-600: #475569;
            --gray-700: #334155;
            --gray-800: #1E293B;
            --gray-900: #0F172A;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            color: var(--gray-800);
            line-height: 1.6;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        a {
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
        }

        img {
            max-width: 100%;
            height: auto;
        }

        .container {
            max-width: 1280px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 24px;
        }

        /* Header */
        .header {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            background: var(--navy);
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: background 0.3s ease;
        }

        .header-inner {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            height: 72px;
        }

        .logo {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--white);
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
        }

        .logo span {
            color: var(--teal-light);
        }

        .nav-desktop {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 32px;
        }

        .nav-link {
            color: var(--gray-300);
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            padding: 24px 0;
            position: relative;
            transition: color 0.2s ease;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .nav-link:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .nav-link.services-trigger {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .nav-link.services-trigger::after {
            content: '';
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
            border-left: 4px solid transparent;
            border-right: 4px solid transparent;
            border-top: 4px solid currentColor;
            transition: transform 0.2s ease;
        }

        .nav-link.services-trigger:hover::after,
        .nav-link.services-trigger.active::after {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
        }

        .nav-link-highlight {
            color: var(--gold-light);
        }

        /* Mega Menu */
        .mega-menu {
            position: absolute;
            top: 100%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            min-width: 600px;
            padding: 32px;
        }

        .mega-menu-trigger:hover .mega-menu,
        .mega-menu-trigger.active .mega-menu {
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
        }

        .mega-menu-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 32px;
        }

        .mega-menu-section h4 {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            color: var(--gray-500);
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .mega-menu-items {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .mega-menu-item {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--gray-700);
            transition: color 0.2s ease;
        }

        .mega-menu-item:hover {
            color: var(--teal);
        }

        /* Mobile Nav Toggle */
        .mobile-nav-toggle {
            display: none;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 8px;
        }

        .mobile-nav-toggle span {
            display: block;
            width: 24px;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--white);
            margin: 5px 0;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* Mobile Navigation */
        .nav-mobile {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 72px;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: var(--navy);
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 24px;
        }

        .nav-mobile.active {
            display: block;
        }

        .mobile-nav-item {
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-700);
        }

        .mobile-nav-link {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 16px 0;
            color: var(--white);
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 500;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            width: 100%;
            cursor: pointer;
            text-align: left;
        }

        .mobile-nav-link .arrow {
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .mobile-nav-link.active .arrow {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
        }

        .mobile-subnav {
            max-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: max-height 0.3s ease;
        }

        .mobile-subnav.active {
            max-height: 500px;
        }

        .mobile-subnav a {
            display: block;
            padding: 12px 0 12px 16px;
            color: var(--gray-400);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-light) 100%);
            overflow: hidden;
            padding-top: 72px;
        }

        .hero::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect fill="none" stroke="%23ffffff" stroke-width="0.1" x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100"/></svg>');
            background-size: 50px 50px;
            opacity: 0.05;
        }

        .hero-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            max-width: 800px;
        }

        .hero-label {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--teal);
            color: var(--white);
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--white);
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            letter-spacing: -1px;
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--gray-300);
            line-height: 1.7;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            max-width: 600px;
        }

        .btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 14px 28px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            cursor: pointer;
            border: none;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: var(--gold);
            color: var(--navy);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            background: var(--gold-light);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--white);
            border: 2px solid var(--gray-500);
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            border-color: var(--white);
        }

        .btn-outline {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--teal);
            border: 2px solid var(--teal);
        }

        .btn-outline:hover {
            background: var(--teal);
            color: var(--white);
        }

        /* Announcement Banner */
        .announcement-banner {
            background: var(--teal);
            padding: 16px 0;
        }

        .announcement-inner {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 16px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .announcement-banner p {
            color: var(--white);
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .announcement-banner .btn {
            background: var(--white);
            color: var(--teal);
            padding: 10px 20px;
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .announcement-banner .btn:hover {
            background: var(--gray-100);
        }

        /* About Statement */
        .about-statement {
            padding: 120px 0;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .about-content {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .about-statement h2 {
            font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--navy);
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
        }

        .about-statement p {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--gray-600);
            line-height: 1.8;
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        /* Featured Insights */
        .featured-insights {
            padding: 100px 0;
            background: var(--gray-50);
        }

        .section-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 48px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 24px;
        }

        .section-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            color: var(--teal);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--navy);
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
        }

        .featured-insights-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 32px;
        }

        .featured-insight-card {
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }

        .featured-insight-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
        }

        .featured-insight-image {
            height: 200px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-light) 0%, var(--navy) 100%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: var(--gray-500);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .featured-insight-content {
            padding: 24px;
        }

        .insight-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            color: var(--teal);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .featured-insight-card h3 {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--navy);
            line-height: 1.4;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .featured-insight-card p {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--gray-500);
        }

        /* What We Do Section */
        .what-we-do {
            padding: 120px 0;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .what-we-do-wrapper {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr;
            gap: 64px;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .what-we-do-tabs {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 4px;
            position: sticky;
            top: 100px;
        }

        .what-we-do-tab {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            padding: 16px 20px;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            text-align: left;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--gray-600);
        }

        .what-we-do-tab:hover {
            background: var(--gray-50);
        }

        .what-we-do-tab.active {
            background: var(--navy);
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .what-we-do-tab .tab-icon {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: var(--gray-200);
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .what-we-do-tab.active .tab-icon {
            background: var(--teal);
        }

        .what-we-do-content {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 32px;
        }

        .what-we-do-panel {
            display: none;
        }

        .what-we-do-panel.active {
            display: block;
        }

        .what-we-do-panel h3 {
            font-size: 32px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--navy);
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
        }

        .what-we-do-panel p {
            font-size: 17px;
            color: var(--gray-600);
            line-height: 1.8;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .what-we-do-list {
            list-style: none;
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        .what-we-do-list li {
            padding: 8px 0;
            padding-left: 24px;
            position: relative;
            color: var(--gray-700);
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .what-we-do-list li::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(--teal);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        /* Latest Insights */
        .latest-insights {
            padding: 100px 0;
            background: var(--gray-50);
        }

        .insights-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
            gap: 32px;
        }

        .insight-card {
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .insight-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
        }

        .insight-image {
            height: 180px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-light) 0%, var(--teal) 100%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: var(--white);
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .insight-content {
            padding: 24px;
        }

        .insight-meta {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .insight-type {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            color: var(--teal);
        }

        .insight-date {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gray-400);
        }

        .insight-card h3 {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--navy);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* Newsletter */
        .newsletter {
            padding: 100px 0;
            background: var(--navy);
        }

        .newsletter-inner {
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .newsletter h2 {
            font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--white);
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
        }

        .newsletter p {
            font-size: 17px;
            color: var(--gray-400);
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        .newsletter-form {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .newsletter-form input {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 250px;
            padding: 14px 20px;
            font-size: 15px;
            border: 2px solid var(--gray-600);
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .newsletter-form input::placeholder {
            color: var(--gray-500);
        }

        .newsletter-form input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--teal);
        }

        /* Our Commitment */
        .our-commitment {
            padding: 120px 0;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .commitment-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 32px;
        }

        .commitment-card {
            padding: 32px;
            background: var(--gray-50);
            border-radius: 12px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .commitment-card:hover {
            background: var(--navy);
        }

        .commitment-card:hover h3,
        .commitment-card:hover p {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .commitment-card:hover .commitment-icon {
            background: var(--teal);
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .commitment-icon {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .commitment-card h3 {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--navy);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .commitment-card p {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--gray-600);
            line-height: 1.7;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .commitment-link {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--teal);
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            transition: gap 0.2s ease;
        }

        .commitment-card:hover .commitment-link {
            color: var(--gold-light);
        }

        .commitment-link:hover {
            gap: 10px;
        }

        /* Footer */
        .footer {
            background: var(--navy);
            padding: 80px 0 40px;
        }

        mobileSubnavLinks.forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const subnavId = link.dataset.subnav + '-subnav';
                const subnav = document.getElementById(subnavId);
                link.classList.toggle('active');
                subnav.classList.toggle('active');
            });
        });

        const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.what-we-do-panel');

                const targetTab = tab.dataset.tab;

                tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                tab.classList.add('active');

                panels.forEach(panel => {
                    panel.classList.remove('active');

                        panel.classList.add('active');
                    }
                });
            });
        });

    <script>
        // Mobile Navigation Toggle
        const mobileNavToggle = document.getElementById('mobileNavToggle');
        const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');

        mobileNavToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
            mobileNavToggle.classList.toggle('active');
            mobileNav.classList.toggle('active');
        });

        // Mobile Subnav Accordion
        const mobileSubnavLinks = document.querySelectorAll('[data-subnav]');
        mobileSubnavLinks.forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const subnavId = link.dataset.subnav + '-subnav';
                const subnav = document.getElementById(subnavId);
                link.classList.toggle('active');
                subnav.classList.toggle('active');
            });
        });

        // What We Do Tabs
        const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.what-we-do-tab');
        const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.what-we-do-panel');

        tabs.forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const targetTab = tab.dataset.tab;

                tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                tab.classList.add('active');

                panels.forEach(panel => {
                    panel.classList.remove('active');
                    if (panel.id === 'panel-' + targetTab) {
                        panel.classList.add('active');
                    }
                });
            });
        });

        // Mega Menu Hover Intent
        const megaMenuTrigger = document.querySelector('.mega-menu-trigger');

        megaMenuTrigger.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            megaMenuTrigger.querySelector('.services-trigger').classList.add('active');
        });

        megaMenuTrigger.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            megaMenuTrigger.querySelector('.services-trigger').classList.remove('active');
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        // Mobile Navigation Toggle
        const mobileNavToggle = document.getElementById('mobileNavToggle');
        const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');

        mobileNavToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
            mobileNavToggle.classList.toggle('active');
            mobileNav.classList.toggle('active');
        });

        // Mobile Subnav Accordion
        const mobileSubnavLinks = document.querySelectorAll('[data-subnav]');
        mobileSubnavLinks.forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const subnavId = link.dataset.subnav + '-subnav';
                const subnav = document.getElementById(subnavId);
                link.classList.toggle('active');
                subnav.classList.toggle('active');
            });
        });

        // What We Do Tabs
        const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.what-we-do-tab');
        const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.what-we-do-panel');

        tabs.forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const targetTab = tab.dataset.tab;

                tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                tab.classList.add('active');

                panels.forEach(panel => {
                    panel.classList.remove('active');
                    if (panel.id === 'panel-' + targetTab) {
                        panel.classList.add('active');
                    }
                });
            });
        });

        // Mega Menu Hover Intent
        const megaMenuTrigger = document.querySelector('.mega-menu-trigger');

        megaMenuTrigger.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            megaMenuTrigger.querySelector('.services-trigger').classList.add('active');
        });

        megaMenuTrigger.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            megaMenuTrigger.querySelector('.services-trigger').classList.remove('active');
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>GlobalStone — Global Commercial Real Estate Services</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

    <style>
        *, *::before, *::after {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {

            --navy-light: #1A2B4A;
            --teal: #0D7377;

        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            color: var(--gray-800);
            line-height: 1.6;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        a {

        .container {

        /* Header */
        .header {

        .header-inner {

        .nav-desktop {

        .nav-link {

        .nav-link.services-trigger {

        .nav-link.services-trigger::after {

            border-right: 4px solid transparent;
            border-top: 4px solid currentColor;
            transition: transform 0.2s ease;
        }

        .nav-link.services-trigger:hover::after,
        .nav-link.services-trigger.active::after {

        .nav-link-highlight {

        /* Mega Menu */
        .mega-menu {

            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
            opacity: 0;

            min-width: 600px;
            padding: 32px;

        .mega-menu-trigger:hover .mega-menu,

        .mega-menu-section h4 {

            color: var(--gray-500);
            margin-bottom: 16px;

        .mega-menu-items {

            gap: 12px;
        }

        .mega-menu-item {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--gray-700);
            transition: color 0.2s ease;
        }

        .mega-menu-item:hover {
            color: var(--teal);

        /* Mobile Nav Toggle */
        .mobile-nav-toggle {

            background: none;
            border: none;

        .nav-mobile.active {

            border: none;

        .mobile-nav-link .arrow {

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {

        .hero::before {

            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect fill="none" stroke="%23ffffff" stroke-width="0.1" x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100"/></svg>');

        .hero p {

        }

        .btn {

        /* Announcement Banner */
        .announcement-banner {
            background: var(--teal);
            padding: 16px 0;
        }

        .announcement-inner {
            display: flex;

        .insights-grid {

        .insight-card {

        .insight-image {

            background: var(--teal);

        }

        .commitment-icon {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .commitment-card h3 {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--navy);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .commitment-card p {
            font-size: 14px;

                overflow-x: auto;

                gap: 8px;

            }

            .what-we-do-tab {

                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .nav-desktop {
                display: none;
            }

            .mobile-nav-toggle {
                display: block;
            }

            .hero-content {
                text-align: center;
            }

            .hero p {
                margin-left: auto;
                margin-right: auto;
            }

            .hero-buttons {
                justify-content: center;
                flex-wrap: wrap;
            }

            .section-header {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start;
            }

            .footer-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .footer-bottom {
                flex-direction: column;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .footer-legal {
                flex-wrap: wrap;
                justify-content: center;
            }
        }

        /* Animations */
        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        .fade-in {
            animation: fadeIn 0.6s ease forwards;
        }

        /* Mobile menu animation */
        .mobile-nav-toggle.active span:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
        }

        .mobile-nav-toggle.active span:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .mobile-nav-toggle.active span:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px);
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Header -->
    <header class="header">

            <nav class="nav-desktop">

        });

                const targetTab = tab.dataset.tab;

                tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                tab.classList.add('active');

                panels.forEach(panel => {
                    panel.classList.remove('active');
                    if (panel.id === 'panel-' + targetTab) {
                        panel.classList.add('active');
                    }
                });

            --teal-light: #14919B;
            --gold: #C9A227;
            --gold-light: #D4AF37;
            --white: #FFFFFF;

            --gray-100: #F1F5F9;
            --gray-200: #E2E8F0;
            --gray-300: #CBD5E1;

        }

            height: auto;

        .container {

            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 24px;

        /* Header */
        .header {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            background: var(--navy);
            z-index: 1000;
        }

        .header-inner {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            height: 72px;
        }

        .logo {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--white);
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
        }

        .logo span {
            color: var(--teal-light);
        }

        .nav-desktop {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 32px;
        }

        .nav-link {
            color: var(--gray-300);
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            padding: 24px 0;
            position: relative;
            transition: color 0.2s ease;
        }

        .nav-link:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .nav-link.services-trigger {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .nav-link.services-trigger::after {
            content: '';
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
            border-left: 4px solid transparent;
            border-right: 4px solid transparent;
            border-top: 4px solid currentColor;
            transition: transform 0.2s ease;
        }

        .nav-link.services-trigger:hover::after,
        .nav-link.services-trigger.active::after {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
        }

        .nav-link-highlight {
            color: var(--gold-light);
        }

        .nav-link.active {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .mega-menu {
            position: absolute;
            top: 100%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            min-width: 600px;
            padding: 32px;
        }

        .mega-menu-trigger:hover .mega-menu,
        .mega-menu-trigger.active .mega-menu {
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
        }

        .mega-menu-grid {

            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 32px;

            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            color: var(--gray-500);
            margin-bottom: 16px;

            color: var(--gray-700);

        .mobile-nav-toggle {

            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;

            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 24px;

        .nav-mobile.active {

        .mobile-nav-item {

        .mobile-nav-link {

            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 500;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            width: 100%;
            cursor: pointer;
            text-align: left;
        }

        .mobile-nav-link .arrow {
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .mobile-nav-link.active .arrow {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
        }

        .mobile-subnav {
            max-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: max-height 0.3s ease;
        }

        .mobile-subnav.active {
            max-height: 500px;

        .mobile-subnav a {

            color: var(--gray-400);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .page-hero {

        .page-hero::before {

        .page-hero h1 {
            font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);

            color: var(--white);
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            letter-spacing: -1px;

        .page-hero p {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--gray-300);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        /* Intro Statement */
        .intro-statement {
            padding: 100px 0;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .intro-content {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .intro-statement h2 {
            font-size: clamp(24px, 4vw, 40px);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--navy);
            line-height: 1.3;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;

        .intro-statement p {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--gray-600);
            line-height: 1.8;
        }

        /* Capabilities Grid */
        .capabilities-grid-section {
            padding: 80px 0 100px;
            background: var(--gray-50);
        }

        .section-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;

        .capabilities-grid {
            display: grid;

            gap: 32px;
        }

        .capability-card {
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 40px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .capability-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);
            box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);

        .capability-card-icon {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;

            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;

            font-size: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .capability-card h3 {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--navy);
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .capability-card p {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--gray-600);
            line-height: 1.7;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .capability-link {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--teal);
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            transition: gap 0.2s ease;

        .capability-link:hover {
            gap: 12px;
            color: var(--navy);
        }

        /* Featured Partners Carousel */
        .featured-partners {
            padding: 100px 0;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .carousel-container {
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .carousel-track {
            display: flex;
            gap: 32px;
            transition: transform 0.5s ease;
        }

        .partner-card {
            flex: 0 0 calc(33.333% - 22px);

            background: var(--gray-50);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 40px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .partner-logo {
            width: 80px;
            height: 80px;
            background: var(--navy);
            border-radius: 50%;

            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--white);

        .partner-card h4 {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--navy);
            margin-bottom: 12px;

        .partner-card p {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--gray-600);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

            display: flex;

            gap: 16px;

        .carousel-btn {

            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 20px;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;

        .carousel-btn:hover {
            background: var(--navy);
            border-color: var(--navy);
            color: var(--white);
        }

        /* Deal Flow CTA */
        .deal-flow-cta {
            padding: 100px 0;
            background: var(--navy);
        }

        .deal-flow-content {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;

            flex-wrap: wrap;

        .deal-flow-text {

        .deal-flow-cta h2 {

            margin-bottom: 16px;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;

        .deal-flow-cta p {
            font-size: 17px;
            color: var(--gray-300);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .deal-flow-cta .btn {
            background: var(--gold);
            color: var(--navy);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .deal-flow-cta .btn:hover {
            background: var(--gold-light);
        }

        /* Testimonial */
        .testimonial {
            padding: 100px 0;
            background: var(--gray-50);
        }

        .testimonial-content {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .testimonial-quote {
            font-size: clamp(20px, 3vw, 28px);
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--navy);
            line-height: 1.6;
            font-style: italic;
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        .testimonial-author {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .testimonial-avatar {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            background: var(--teal);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: var(--white);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .testimonial-info h4 {
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--navy);
        }

        .testimonial-info p {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--gray-500);
        }

        /* Featured Topics */
        .featured-topics {
            padding: 100px 0;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .featured-topics-wrapper {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 64px;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .topics-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .topic-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 20px 24px;
            background: var(--gray-50);
            border-radius: 12px;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;

        .topic-item:hover {
            background: var(--navy);

        .topic-item:hover h4,

        .topic-item h4 {
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--navy);
            transition: color 0.2s ease;
        }

        .topic-arrow {
            color: var(--teal);

            transition: color 0.2s ease;

            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--navy);
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .topics-sidebar p {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--gray-600);
            line-height: 1.7;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .property-types-cta {
            padding: 100px 0;
            background: var(--teal);

        .property-types-cta h2 {
            font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--white);
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;

            color: var(--gray-200);
            margin-bottom: 32px;

        .property-types-grid {

        .footer-col a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .footer-bottom {
