            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .footer-legal {
            display: flex;
            gap: 24px;
        }

        .footer-legal a {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--gray-500);
        }

        .footer-legal a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .footer-copyright {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--gray-500);
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .featured-topics-wrapper {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .footer-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }

            .partner-card {
                flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 16px);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .nav-desktop {
                display: none;
            }

            .mobile-nav-toggle {
                display: block;
            }

            .page-hero {
                padding: 140px 0 80px;
            }

            .page-hero-content {
                text-align: center;
            }

            .capabilities-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .deal-flow-content {
                flex-direction: column;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .partner-card {
                flex: 0 0 100%;
            }

            .footer-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .footer-bottom {
                flex-direction: column;
                text-align: center;
            }

            .footer-legal {
                flex-wrap: wrap;
                justify-content: center;
            }

        /* Mobile menu animation */
        .mobile-nav-toggle.active span:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);

        .mobile-nav-toggle.active span:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .mobile-nav-toggle.active span:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px);
        }

        /* Button */
        .btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 14px 28px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            cursor: pointer;
            border: none;
        }

        .btn-outline {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--teal);
            border: 2px solid var(--teal);
        }

        .btn-outline:hover {
            background: var(--teal);
            color: var(--white);
        }

                link.classList.toggle('active');
                subnav.classList.toggle('active');
            });

        mobileNavToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
            mobileNavToggle.classList.toggle('active');
            mobileNav.classList.toggle('active');
        });

        // Mobile Subnav Accordion
        const mobileSubnavLinks = document.querySelectorAll('[data-subnav]');
        mobileSubnavLinks.forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const subnavId = link.dataset.subnav + '-subnav';
                const subnav = document.getElementById(subnavId);
                link.classList.toggle('active');
                subnav.classList.toggle('active');
            });
        });

        // Mega Menu Hover Intent
        const megaMenuTrigger = document.querySelector('.mega-menu-trigger');

        megaMenuTrigger.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            megaMenuTrigger.querySelector('.services-trigger').classList.add('active');
        });

        megaMenuTrigger.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            megaMenuTrigger.querySelector('.services-trigger').classList.remove('active');
        });

        // Carousel
        let carouselPosition = 0;
        const track = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');

        function moveCarousel(direction) {
            const cardWidth = track.querySelector('.partner-card').offsetWidth + 32;
            const maxPosition = track.querySelectorAll('.partner-card').length - 3;
            carouselPosition += direction;
            carouselPosition = Math.max(0, Math.min(carouselPosition, maxPosition));
            track.style.transform = `translateX(-${carouselPosition * cardWidth}px)`;
        }

                link.classList.toggle('active');
                subnav.classList.toggle('active');
            });

            carouselPosition = Math.max(0, Math.min(carouselPosition, maxPosition));
